svg.title: The whole system runs on your machine
svg.desc: OCR VBHC architecture. Digitise: PDF or image, render pages, Chandra OCR 2 on llama-server port 9999, page quality gate, 12 fields of Decree 30. Store in SQLite: documents and versions, FTS5 full text, folded FTS5, sqlite-vec with bge-m3 vectors, legal relations, conversations. Ask: question, hybrid retrieval fused with RRF, ViRanker, Qwen3 assistant on llama-server port 9998 (conversation state, document resolver, metadata tables, tools, answer check), answer with citations. Everything stays inside the user's machine; no data leaves it.
